apps.name: Ghost Hub
apps.description: Every Ghost app in one place. Install and update them anywhere, from GitHub or your PC.
changes: Cleaner look: a search box, and apps sorted into Tools, Everyday and Games & fun.
New settings sheet with Update history (every install and update, with versions and times), Share Ghost Hub and Clear downloads.
Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.

apps.name: Ghost GPS
apps.description: Set your location anywhere: teleport, walk a route or steer with the joystick.
changes: 🎲 Random walk: pick a length and Ghost GPS draws a loop around where you are.
Import routes from other map or fitness apps as GPX files, and save your routes as GPX.
New Routes sheet, rename saved routes, and rename favourites (long-press a favourite).
The icon is back to the original Ghost GPS ghost.

apps.name: Ghost Volume
apps.description: Your own volume for every app, switched automatically when you open it.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
Headphone volume limit: cap media volume whenever headphones or Bluetooth are connected, to look after your ears.
Sound / Vibrate / Silent buttons for your ringer, right above the system volumes.

apps.name: Ghost Terminal
apps.description: A shell on your phone, with a side list of commands that work on your device.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
Small test update: checks Ghost Hub can now update apps without asking you.
Colour output: 'ls --color' and friends now show real colours instead of odd symbols.

apps.name: Ghost Weather
apps.description: Live weather where you are and anywhere you save: hourly, 7-day, rain alerts at a glance.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
New Air quality tile (with PM2.5) and a Daylight tile that says if tomorrow is longer or shorter.
Optional morning rain alert at 7:30 when rain is likely today.

apps.name: Ghost School
apps.description: Homework, timetable, grades, targets, exams and revision, with XP, levels and badges.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
Home-screen widget: what's on now or next, and how much homework is due.
Two-week timetables (Week A / Week B), homework notes, and your own reminder time with exam heads-ups.

apps.name: Ghost Image Editor
apps.description: Crop, rotate, filters, adjust, draw and add text to your photos. Nothing leaves your phone.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
New Frame tool: add a border, or make a photo square with a colour or blurred background.
Straighten slider, plus Blur, Pixelate and Marker brushes to hide private details.

apps.name: Ghost VPN
apps.description: One-tap VPN through free volunteer servers in many countries. Tests servers from your phone to find the fastest.
changes: The connect button now has the ghost in it, and gets a green shield when you're protected.
Fastest-for-you tiles: the quickest countries from your phone, one tap to connect.
Region filters (Europe, Americas, Asia), neat time and data tiles, and a new session history with weekly totals.
Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.

apps.name: Ghost Browser
apps.description: A private browser: ad & tracker blocker, incognito tabs, and sites forget you when you leave.
changes: A clean new menu: quick buttons (forward, reload, bookmark, share, find) and a tidy grid for everything else.
Closed a tab by mistake? Tap Undo, or Reopen tab from the menu (normal tabs only, never saved).
Tidier start page with a greeting and privacy stat tiles.
Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.

apps.name: Ghost Video
apps.description: Video editor: trim, filters, colour, speed, rotate, captions and sound. Saved on your phone.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
Crop to a shape (Square, Story, Portrait, Wide) with a live crop box.
Join clips: add more videos to play after this one when you export.

apps.name: Ghost Dice
apps.description: Dice (d4 to d20), a coin, random numbers, a decision wheel and a magic ghost ball.
changes: Big 2.0 update with 5 tabs: Dice, Coin, Number, Wheel and Ask.
Dice from d4 to d20, up to 6 at once. Tap a die to hold it, and shake your phone to roll.
Decision wheel you can edit (knock-out mode, team splitter), a no-repeats raffle, coin streaks and a magic ghost ball.
Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.

apps.name: Ghost Counter
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
New app: a big tap counter with +1/+2/+5/+10 steps, a name for what you're counting, and your highest count remembered.

apps.name: Ghost Graph War
apps.description: Graphwar with ghosts: shoot functions across the map at bots or a friend. Cheats built in.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
New game: type a function to shoot, just like Graphwar. y =, y' and y'' boxes, 6 kinds of map, 1-4 ghosts a team.
Play easy, normal or hard bots, or pass the phone to a friend.

apps.name: Ghost Cookie Clicker
apps.description: Tap the ghost cookie, hire spooky bakers and bake billions.
changes: Big 2.0 update: a night-sky scene, a nicer cookie with a blinking face, cursors circling it and milk that rises with achievements.
Ascend for ghost souls (+2% each, forever), 3 new buildings, Buy Max, sell buildings (hold one) and a Buy-all-upgrades button.
Golden ghosts can start a cookie storm to catch, plus a news ticker, lots more achievements and a save code to back up your game.
Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.

apps.name: Ghost Invest
apps.description: Practise investing with £10,000 of pretend money on real, live meme coin, crypto and stock prices.
changes: Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
New app: buy and sell 15 meme coins, Bitcoin, Solana and 10 big stocks with practice money, at live prices.
Practice trading bots (dip buyer, steady buyer, momentum rider) that run on real prices, even when the app's closed.

apps.name: Ghost Bot
apps.description: A meme-coin trading bot with its own pretend-money wallet, trading at real live prices.
changes: Starts straight away: with Jump in on, the bot makes its first buy the moment you press Start.
Live radar of the biggest movers, a bar showing how close it is to its next buy or sell, and B/S marks on the chart.
Choose how often it looks (15 s / 30 s / 1 min), tap to look now, share a run's result, and see your best run and win rate.
Icon: the classic Ghost GPS ghost is back, now on every Ghost app, with this app's badge in the corner.
